ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
Sort(
    Filter('CH-Tbl-ValidationResults',
        ValidationRun = First(Sort(Filter('CH-Tbl-ValidationRuns', SourceRecordID = Text(Table1_1.Selected.'CH-Tbl-Received Emails')), 'Created On', SortOrder.Descending)),
        ValidationResult = 'ValidationResult (CH-Tbl-ValidationResults)'.Fail),
    Name)

With({ejec: Filter('CH-Tbl-ValidationResults', ValidationRun = First(Sort(Filter('CH-Tbl-ValidationRuns', SourceRecordID = Text(Table1_1.Selected.'CH-Tbl-Received Emails')), 'Created On', SortOrder.Descending)))},
    Filter('CH-Tbl-ValidationRules',
        IsActive = true,
        IsBlank(LookUp(ejec, ValidationRule.'Validation Name' = 'Validation Name'))))

With({r: First(Sort(Filter('CH-Tbl-ValidationRuns', SourceRecordID = Text(Table1_1.Selected.'CH-Tbl-Received Emails')), 'Created On', SortOrder.Descending))},
    With({res: Filter('CH-Tbl-ValidationResults', ValidationRun = r)},
        If(IsBlank(r),
           "Este correo no tiene ninguna corrida de validacion todavia.",
           CountRows(Filter(res, ValidationResult = 'ValidationResult (CH-Tbl-ValidationResults)'.Fail)) & " fallaron   |   " &
           (CountRows(Filter('CH-Tbl-ValidationRules', IsActive = true)) - CountRows(res)) & " no se intentaron   |   " &
           CountRows(Filter(res, ValidationResult = 'ValidationResult (CH-Tbl-ValidationResults)'.Pass)) & " pasaron sin novedad")))
UpdateContext({ isItemSelected: true, newMode: false, CurrentItem:Table1_1.Selected })
